scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer waving hello in a sunny Malaysian kampung village with coconut trees and a wooden house on stilts
scenes.say: Selamat datang! Hello friend! I'm Cil, the clever little mousedeer. Today I'm going on a big trip to Kuala Lumpur, and you're coming with me! Along the way, we'll learn fifteen new Malay words. Ready? Let's go!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer waking up in a cosy wooden kampung house, sniffing the air curiously, morning sunlight
scenes.say: Chapter one. A smelly morning! Cil wakes up and sniffs the air. Hmm, something smells funny...

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer holding its nose next to a pile of damp crumpled laundry with green wavy smell lines
scenes.say: Hapak. Ha. Pak. Hapak! Hapak is the yucky smell of clothes that stayed wet too long. Eww! Baju ini hapak! These clothes smell musty!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer making a disgusted face at a frying pan of old dark brown cooking oil with stinky smell lines
scenes.say: Tengik. Teng. Ik. Tengik! Tengik is the smell of old, spoiled cooking oil. Minyak ini tengik! This oil smells bad. Don't fry with it!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer at the beach tasting seawater with a scrunched up salty face, little salt crystals sparkling
scenes.say: Masin. Ma. Sin. Masin! Masin means salty. Air laut masin! Sea water is salty. Bleh!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer biting a green lime slice with a super puckered sour face, eyes squeezed shut
scenes.say: Masam. Ma. Sam. Masam! Masam means sour, like a lime. Limau ini masam! This lime is so sour! Fun fact: muka masam, a sour face, means a grumpy face!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer wearing a small chef apron in a bright kampung kitchen with pots and a basket of vegetables
scenes.say: Chapter two. Cooking lunch! Cil is hungry. Time to cook some fish!

scenes.meaning: to clean, scale and gut a fish
scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer in an apron carefully cleaning and scaling a fish at a kitchen sink, shiny fish scales flying
scenes.say: Menyiang ikan. Me. Nyi. Ang. I. Kan. Menyiang ikan! It means to clean a fish before cooking: take off the scales and clean the inside. Ikan means fish. Cil sedang menyiang ikan. Cil is cleaning the fish!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer adding one small teaspoon of salt into a cooking pot of fish curry, careful concentrated face
scenes.say: Menambah sesudu kecil garam. Menambah means adding. Sesudu kecil means one small spoon, a teaspoon. Garam means salt. So: adding a teaspoon of salt! Just one! Not too masin!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer meeting forest animal friends, a monkey, a turtle and a bird, under a big tree
scenes.say: Chapter three. Feelings and fun! Cil's friends come to visit.

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer shyly peeking out from behind a big green leaf with rosy pink blushing cheeks
scenes.say: Segan. Se. Gan. Segan! Segan means shy, or feeling a bit embarrassed. In Chinese, bu hao yi si. Cil segan bila bertemu kawan baru. Cil feels shy when meeting new friends.

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer and animal friends sitting in cinema seats eating popcorn, watching a glowing movie screen
scenes.say: Wayang. Wa. Yang. Wayang! Wayang means movie. Jom tengok wayang! Let's watch a movie! Popcorn, anyone?

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer sitting at a little wooden table with a paper map and pencil, thinking hard
scenes.say: Chapter four. Making plans! Cil wants to go on a trip.

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer with a big thought bubble showing a city skyline with two tall towers, excited face
scenes.say: Bercadang. Ber. Ca. Dang. Bercadang! Bercadang means planning to do something. Cil bercadang pergi ke Kuala Lumpur. Cil plans to go to Kuala Lumpur!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer explaining with one hoof raised, pointing at a picture of a tall building and a toy shop
scenes.say: Sebab. Se. Bab. Sebab! Sebab means because, or the reason. Cil mahu pergi sebab KL sangat menarik. Cil wants to go because KL is very interesting!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer, a monkey and a bird cheering and ready to travel, while a sleepy turtle snores in the corner
scenes.say: Kecuali. Ke. Cu. A. Li. Kecuali! Kecuali means except. Semua kawan ikut, kecuali Kura-kura. All the friends are coming, except Turtle. He's too sleepy! Zzz.

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer proudly holding up and pointing at a big map to its animal friends
scenes.say: Menunjukkan. Me. Nun. Juk. Kan. Menunjukkan! Menunjukkan means to show. Cil menunjukkan peta kepada kawan-kawan. Cil shows the map to his friends.

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer with a tiny backpack and animal friends setting off on a road trip at sunrise
scenes.say: Chapter five. Off to K L! Here we go!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer looking at a colourful line of vehicles: a car, a bus, a motorbike, a train and a bicycle
scenes.say: Kenderaan. Ken. De. Ra. An. Kenderaan! Kenderaan means vehicle. Cars, buses, motorbikes, trains: semua kenderaan! They are all vehicles!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer happily walking across a very shallow river, water only up to its tiny ankles, pebbles visible
scenes.say: Air sungai menjadi cetek. Air means water. Sungai means river. Menjadi means became. Cetek means shallow. So: the river water became shallow! Now Cil can walk across. Splish splash!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer waving from a car window driving past the twin towers city skyline of Kuala Lumpur
scenes.say: Melalui Kuala Lumpur. Me. La. Lu. I. Melalui! Melalui means passing through. Kami melalui Kuala Lumpur! We are passing through Kuala Lumpur. Wow, look at those tall towers!

scenes.img: Cil the mousedeer waving goodbye at sunset with animal friends, confetti and stars
scenes.say: Wow, you learned fifteen Malay words today! Bagus! Great job! Practise them again tomorrow, okay? Jumpa lagi! See you again!
